title: Mrs. Claus Welcome Table – Wilderness Club
seo_title: Mrs. Claus Welcome Table at Wilderness Club, Ridgedale
description: Mrs. Claus and the elves host a Holiday Welcome Table in the Brushy Creek Clubhouse, serving holiday cookies and taking photos with you and your family. It takes place Sunday, November 15, 2026, from 3:00 to 4:00 PM at the Wilderness Club at Big Cedar Lodge, 1285 Estate Dr in Ridgedale, Missouri.
venue: Wilderness Club at Big Cedar Lodge
